metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly cooling sport towels for teams or events. Soft, absorbent, and quick-cooling. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Cotton poly cooling sport towels combine the softness of cotton with the quick-drying properties of polyester, making them ideal for outdoor events, sports teams, and construction crews. Unlike 100% synthetic towels, the cotton blend feels gentle on skin while still activating with water for instant cooling. These towels are popular for corporate wellness programs and summer giveaways, and they accept full-color screen printing or embroidery for lasting brand visibility.
